start: Settings → 'Bring in your workouts from another app', a Hevy workout .csv saved on the phone with 'Push 1', 'Pull 1' and 'Legs 1' each done 3 or more times

steps.action: Under 'Which app are you moving from?' tap Hevy
user_sees: 'Your workout file, or a link to a shared routine.'
Steps 'Open Hevy and go to Settings → Export & Backup Data.' …
'After your workouts come in, we build your routines from the workouts you repeat most.'
must_not: A promise that Hevy's saved routines come in from the file

steps.action: Tap 'Choose Hevy file', pick the file and finish the workout import
user_sees: Workouts added, then a button 'Bring my routines in'
must_not: Routines built before the workouts are in

user_sees: 'Hevy’s file has your workouts but not your saved routines. We built 3 routines from the workouts you repeat most. Tick the ones you want.'
Each routine listed, the ones not used for a year folded under 'older names'
must_not: 'Morning workout' or 'Evening Workout' offered as a routine
A name done only twice offered as a routine

steps.action: Tick all three, tap 'Check these 3', go through with Next
user_sees: 'Sets and reps are from the previous time you did each one. You can change them later in the routine.'
'Also done in Push 1' with exercises not ticked
must_not: Warm-up sets left out
An exercise from another routine ticked by default

steps.action: On 'Follow these as your plan?' tap 'Follow them'
user_sees: '3 routines in From Hevy'
' Up next on the Workout tab: <routine>.'
must_not: The folder named anything but 'From Hevy' on a first import
Today's routine starting from the first in the list instead of the one after the last done

start: Same screen, a Strong workout .csv on the phone

user_sees: 'Your workout file. We build your routines from it.'
'Strong doesn’t export saved routines. After your workouts come in, we build your routines from the workouts you repeat most.'
must_not: Hevy's export steps shown for Strong

steps.action: Import the file and tap 'Bring my routines in'; tick one routine and save it with 'Save without following'
user_sees: 'Strong doesn’t export saved routines. We built 1 routine from the workouts you repeat most. Tick it if you want it.'
'1 routine in From Strong'
must_not: '1 routines'

start: Bring my routines in, after a Hevy file whose workouts all have the app's default names

user_sees: No routine offered, and a plain way to finish
must_not: Default names such as 'Afternoon workout' made into routines
An empty folder 'From Hevy' saved

steps.action: On the check step untick every exercise of every routine and tap Next
user_sees: 'Every exercise is unticked, so there is nothing to save. Go back and tick the ones in each routine.'
A Back button
must_not: An empty routine saved

steps.action: Tick a routine, tap 'Follow them' while the save fails after new exercises were made
user_sees: 'The routines weren’t saved. 2 new exercises were added to your library and stay there. Please try again.'

A success card
